描述_EN: (in winter the water might freeze and crack a ceramic vase.) the japanese loved using antique vases in their flower arrangements, and a few chinese bronze vases, including this one, found their way to japan. a manual on home furnishing published in china in the early 17th century advises the use of ceramic vases for flower arrangement in summer and bronze ones in winter. the story of how it travelled from china to britain is fascinating. in the 19th century a paris dealer bought this vase from its japanese owner and later sold it to the v&a.
描述_ZN: （在冬天，水可能会结冰，使陶瓷花瓶破裂。）日本人喜欢在他们的插花中使用古董花瓶，一些中国的青铜花瓶，包括这个，发现了他们的方式到日本。 17世纪初在中国出版的一本家居手册建议夏天使用陶瓷花瓶插花，冬天使用青铜花瓶。 它是如何从中国来到英国的，这个故事很吸引人。 在19世纪，一个巴黎商人从它的日本主人那里买下了这个花瓶，后来把它卖给了V&A。
